scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: HyperTrace: Hypothesis-Based Preference Tracing for Online LLM Personalization
papers.authors: Jianzhi Shen, Keyu Mao, Minghao Shao, Chuanyang Jin, Yusong Wang, Ailiang Lin, Kotaro Funakoshi, Manabu Okumura, Tianmin Shu, Muhammad Shafique
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.09835v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Personalized language models aim to adapt responses to individual users, whose preferences are often latent and revealed gradually through interaction. Existing training-free methods rely on stored histories or retrieved memories, but they often struggle to reconcile long- term preferences with short-term topic-specific needs. To address this issue, we propose HyperTrace, a training-free framework that formulates online personalization as latent preference tracing. HyperTrace maintains interpretable natural-language hypotheses over short-term intent and long-term preferences, and updates them through an SMC-style reweight process using an LLM-based surrogate choice model. By updating these hypotheses across turns and sessions, HyperTrace enables personalization without parameter updates. Experiments on PRISM and PersonaMem-v2 show that HyperTrace improves response alignment, preference prediction, and profile consistency over strong onli
papers.summary: HyperTrace 将在线个性化建模为隐含偏好追踪，维护五个带权自然语言假设，按选择反馈更新，并分层保存会话意图与长期偏好。在 PRISM 上，20 轮后的偏好预测准确率为 61.36%，高于 Cheatsheet 的 54.36%；在 PersonaMem-v2 上为 37.68%，对应基线为 30.35%。
papers.key_insight: 对社区 UGC 搜索，可借鉴带主题范围的多假设用户画像，区分当前查询需求与长期兴趣，减少一次点击改变整个画像的问题。迁移时必须重新设计点击观测模型，因为论文依赖显式候选比较；文中的准确率与对齐指标均来自离线回放，尚不能视为搜索 CTR 或 nDCG 的线上增益。
papers.scoring_rationale: 用户偏好追踪与搜索个性化密切相关；免训练且提供代码，实验含两个数据集和消融，但显式比较反馈需要适配点击日志。
papers.preference_adjustment_reason: 高商业相关与实用性符合偏好，维度奖励0.05；未命中主题短语。

papers.title: From Retrieval to Weights: Parametric Individualization of Small Language Models with Individual Text Corpora
papers.authors: Christoph Wigbels, Ali Abusaleh, Markus T. Jansen, Alexander Mehler, Markus J. Hofmann
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.10155v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: We approach a cognitive simulation perspective on episodic and semantic memory in multiple-choice question answering by incorporating text from individual text corpora (ITC) into retrieval-augmented generation and DoRA fine-tuning. We web-crawl the search histories of 515 participants who answered 36 multiple-choice knowledge items and analyze a stratified subsample of 150 participants. For each participant, one DoRA adapter consolidates their ITC into a small language model (SLM) whose baseline correctness falls below the participants' lowest quartile. The adapter measurably writes the ITC into the weights: it fits its own participant's held-out text better than other participants' texts (dz =1.27), an individuality effect that increases with ITC size in rank order. papers.summary: 研究用个人搜索历史构成的语料训练 Qwen3-0.6B 的独立 DoRA 适配器，检验参数记忆能否模拟个人知识。150 人的文本评估显示个体效应量为 1.27；138 人的答题评估中，PMI 校正后的个人答案匹配率从 33.7% 降至 32.9%，变化不显著，表明语料适配并未带来更好的个人选择对齐。
papers.key_insight: 社区 UGC 搜索的用户画像评估应区分内容熟悉度、通用知识增加与个体偏好预测。该研究说明，个人语料困惑度下降不足以证明个性化有效；可借鉴自身与他人语料对照、校正读出偏差和保留用户评测的设计，再用实际搜索日志检验 nDCG 与 CTR，避免把泛化提升误归因于用户建模。
papers.scoring_rationale: 核心研究个人搜索语料与个体行为建模，提供有价值的负结果和对照；任务是知识测试，迁移到UGC排序需要较多工作。
papers.preference_adjustment_reason: 未命中优先主题短语，不加分。
